s: Nahshon belongs to tribe Judah
q: Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah

s: Nahshon offered on first day (dedication of the altar)
q: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab

s: Moses set up Tent of Meeting (anointed and sanctified it with all its furniture)
q: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture

s: Elizur is prince of Reuben
q: Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben

s: Eliasaph is prince of Gad
q: Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad

s: princes (heads of the thousands of Israel) is a heads of their fathers' houses (princes of the tribes)
q: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes.

s: dedication offerings of the altar includes twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles (given by the princes of Israel)
q: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

s: dedication offerings of the altar silver weight 2400 shekels (shekel of the sanctuary)
q: all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

s: dedication offerings of the altar gold weight 120 shekels (golden ladles)
q: all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

s: princes (heads of the thousands of Israel) oversee those who were counted
q: These are they who were over those who were counted;

s: wagons and oxen (offering of the princes) consists of six covered wagons and twelve oxen (a wagon for every two princes, an ox for each)
q: six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox.

s: Gershonites receive two wagons and four oxen (according to their service)
q: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

s: Merarites receive four wagons and eight oxen (according to their service)
q: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

s: Merarites serves under Ithamar (direction)
q: under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

s: Ithamar is son of Aaron
q: Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

s: Levites is given to Aaron (as a gift, with his sons, to serve in the Tent of Meeting)
q: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel

s: cleansing of the Levites includes sprinkling with water of cleansing (also shaving the whole body and washing clothes)
q: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

s: wave offering is performed by Aaron (offers the Levites before the LORD)
q: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel

s: Levites replaces firstborn (taken by the LORD instead of the firstborn of Israel)
q: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

s: Levites belongs to LORD (separated from the children of Israel)
q: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

s: Levites serves in Tent of Meeting (under Aaron and his sons)
q: the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons

s: Levites makes atonement for children of Israel (so no plague occurs when they approach the sanctuary)
q: to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

s: firstborn belongs to LORD (both man and animal)
q: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal.

s: firstborn was sanctified by LORD (on the day he struck the firstborn in Egypt)
q: On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

s: LORD speaks to Moses (in the wilderness of Sinai)
q: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

s: foreigner (living among the Israelites) may keep Passover (under the same statute as the native-born)
q: If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance.

s: cloud (over the tabernacle) covers tabernacle (Tent of the Testimony) (appears as fire at night)
q: the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

s: Israel's travel and encampment guided by the cloud is governed by LORD (at his commandment)
q: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped.

s: Israel's travel and encampment guided by the cloud depends on cloud (over the tabernacle) (travel when lifted, encamp where it remains)
q: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

s: Passover is kept on fourteenth day of the first month, at evening (in its appointed season)
q: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season.

s: children of Israel keep Passover (in the first month in the wilderness of Sinai, as the LORD commanded Moses)
q: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai.

s: unclean men (Israelites defiled by a dead body) is unclean because of dead body (of a man, defiling the unclean men)
q: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day

s: second-month Passover provision applies to unclean men (Israelites defiled by a dead body) (also to those on a distant journey)
q: If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

s: second-month Passover provision is kept on fourteenth day of the second month, at evening
q: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it;

s: second-month Passover provision requires eating with unleavened bread and bitter herbs
q: they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

s: Passover forbids leaving any of it until morning or breaking a bone (statute of the Passover)
q: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it.

s: The Book of Amos has title The Book of Amos
The Book of Amos has date -0759/-0749
The Book of Amos has source class canonical
Amos is a herdsman (among the herdsmen of Tekoa)
q: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa

s: Gaza has transgression carrying captive the whole community to Edom (punishment not turned away)
q: For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;

s: Tyre has transgression delivering the whole community to Edom (punishment not turned away)
q: For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;

s: Tyre forgets brotherly covenant
q: didn’t remember the brotherly covenant

s: Edom has transgression pursuing his brother with the sword (punishment not turned away)
q: For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity

s: Edom has disposition continual anger (kept wrath forever)
q: his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever

s: Edom has part Bozrah (palaces devoured by fire)
q: I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.

s: Ammon has transgression ripping open the pregnant women of Gilead (to enlarge their border; punishment not turned away)
q: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.

s: Ammon has part Rabbah (wall of Rabbah)
q: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces

s: Ammon has ruler king of Ammon (will go into captivity with his princes)
q: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says the LORD.

s: Amos is from Tekoa
q: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa

s: Amos prophesies concerning Israel (during reigns of Uzziah and Jeroboam)
q: which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel

s: Jeroboam is a king of Israel
q: Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel

s: Jeroboam is son of Joash
q: Jeroboam the son of Joash

s: the LORD roars from Zion
q: The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem

s: Damascus has transgression threshing Gilead with iron threshing instruments (punishment not turned away)
q: For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;

s: Damascus has part Hazael (house of Hazael)
q: I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

s: Moab burned king of Edom (bones burned into lime; cause of punishment)
q: because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;

s: Israel was brought up by the LORD (brought out of Egypt)
q: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt

s: Israel was led by the LORD (forty years in the wilderness)
q: led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

s: the LORD destroys the Amorite (before Israel; fruit above and roots beneath)
q: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them

s: the LORD raises up prophets (raised from Israel's sons) (from Israel's sons)
q: I raised up some of your sons for prophets

s: the LORD raises up Nazirites (raised from Israel's young men) (from Israel's young men)
q: and some of your young men for Nazirites.

s: Israel gives wine to Nazirites (raised from Israel's young men) (disposition of Israel)
q: But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink

s: Israel commands prophets (raised from Israel's sons) (told not to prophesy)
q: and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’

s: Israel's transgressions and oppression of the poor tramples the poor (heads trampled into the dust of the earth; justice denied to the oppressed)
q: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed.

s: Moab faces coming judgment (fire to devour palaces of Kerioth)
q: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth;

s: coming judgment affects warriors (the swift, strong, mighty) (they cannot escape or deliver themselves)
q: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.

s: Moab has palaces in Kerioth (palaces to be devoured by fire)
q: it will devour the palaces of Kerioth;

s: Judah rejects the LORD's law (cause of punishment)
q: because they have rejected the LORD’s law, and have not kept his statutes

s: Judah faces coming judgment (fire to devour palaces of Jerusalem)
q: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

s: Judah has palaces in Jerusalem (palaces to be devoured by fire)
q: it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

s: Israel commits Israel's transgressions and oppression of the poor (three transgressions, yes four)
q: For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment

s: Israel sells the needy and poor (oppressed by Israel's merchants) (for silver and a pair of sandals)
q: they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;

s: Israel faces coming judgment (to be crushed like a cart full of grain)
q: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.

s: the LORD brought up Israel (out of the land of Egypt)
q: against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt

s: coming punishment and destruction will cut off horns of the altar of Bethel (on the day the LORD visits Israel's transgressions)
q: I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

s: coming punishment and destruction will end houses of ivory and great houses (winter house struck with summer house)
q: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,”

s: the LORD will punish Israel (for all of their sins)
q: Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

s: the LORD has chosen Israel (only family chosen of all the families of the earth)
q: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth.

s: the LORD reveals secret to prophets (raised from Israel's sons) (before acting)
q: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

s: prophets (raised from Israel's sons) is a servants of the Lord GOD
q: unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

s: the LORD is a God of Armies
q: says the Lord GOD, the God of Armies.

s: Israel sits in Samaria (on couch corners and silken cushions of a bed)
q: who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
